structure: A single 37-line Markdown ruling file (workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/ruling-sam-2026-10-26.md) from Sam, dated 26 October 2026, on Save and return to overview. It runs: a heading (line 1); the framing of the BA's find that Save and return to overview skips the checks Save and continue makes on upload documents, origin and main reason for import (lines 3-4); the BA's expected behaviour as a quoted Given/When/Then of three lines (lines 6-8); Sam's 23 October quote, one line, telling the session not to assume the earlier ruling is right because the BA raised it (lines 10-12); Sam's 26 October quote on a documents-only fix, two lines, refusing documents behaving differently and calling for consistency (lines 14-17); then the main session's reading as 4 numbered claims (lines 19-37). Claims 1 and 2 cover Save and return to overview's checks and that no page, upload documents included, is an exception; claim 1 is marked as replacing c-211 and c-313, claim 2 as built as inc-232 in themes/design-snagging-followups. Lines 29-31 then carry a third Sam quote, one line ('happy with recommendations on both'), on the two held engineering-review questions, which claims 3 (Enter in an Identification details card for several animals saves that card, built as inc-224) and 4 (Notification submitted lists the ITAHC as still to upload whenever none was uploaded, built as inc-230) read. Every claim is marked New. Scope is the whole file, so nothing is left out. It is one part: the whole file, well inside what one agent reads word for word.

parts.title: Whole ruling
parts.scope: The whole file: the BA framing and quoted expected behaviour (lines 3-8), Sam's three verbatim quotes (lines 10-12, 14-17 and 29-31) and the 4 numbered claims (lines 19-27 and 33-37). There is no other part.
covers: The BA's find as the file frames it: Save and return to overview skips the checks Save and continue makes on upload documents, origin and main reason for import

The BA's quoted expected behaviour, verbatim: on selecting 'Save and continue' or 'Save and return to overview', an error message for each answer that is missing or not valid, and remaining on the page
Sam's 23 October quote: do not assume the earlier ruling is right, this is the BA raising the issue - what it settles about the standing of the previous ruling, and anything it leaves open
Sam's 26 October quote on a documents-only fix: documents must not behave differently, the BA has given the behaviour we should have, it should be consistent
Sam's 26 October quote on the two held engineering-review questions: 'happy with recommendations on both', and that it accepts a recommendation for each

Claim 1, checked against the quotes: Save and return to overview makes exactly the same checks as Save and continue, on every page that has both buttons, in live animals and high-risk plants; on any missing or invalid answer the trader stays on the page with an error for each one and what they entered is kept; with none, the answers are saved and the overview is shown; it replaces c-211 (the soft save) and c-313 (its plants counterpart), which let Save and return skip blank required answers; marked New

Claim 2, checked against the quotes: no page is an exception, and upload documents follows the same rule - a part-filled document is refused on every save button with an error for each missing detail, and a complete document is saved, never dropped; built as inc-232 in themes/design-snagging-followups; marked New

Claim 3, checked against the 'happy with recommendations on both' quote: on Identification details, pressing Enter in a field of a card for several animals saves that card as its own Save and add another button does, and the trader stays on the page with the entry kept; what a trader typed is never dropped; it replaces the 'safe default' the snagging build pinned in a unit test; built as inc-224; marked New

Claim 4, checked against the same quote: Notification submitted lists the ITAHC as still to upload whenever no ITAHC was uploaded, whatever other documents were; it restores the confirmation spec's original requirement, narrowed to match the code during the snagging build; built as inc-230; marked New

Each claim marked verbatim where the quotes say it in so many words, and inferred otherwise with the statement saying what in the quote implies it - note that claims 3 and 4 rest on a one-line quote accepting two recommendations the file does not itself quote
Every conflict replacement and increment reference the claims cite (c-211, c-313, inc-232, inc-224, inc-230, themes/design-snagging-followups), recorded in the claim's note

Any gap the ruling leaves open on what it touches, recorded as gap claims with an empty quote: the recommendations behind 'happy with recommendations on both' are not quoted in the file, and the ruling names live animals and high-risk plants but not the germinal-products set or any other frontend with both save buttons
